'''Peter Strasser''' (born in [[Heilbronn]]) is a German [[chemist]]. He is the winner of the 2021 [[Faraday Medal (electrochemistry)|Faraday Medal]].<ref name="Faraday">{{cite web |url=https://www.rsc.org/events/detail/47172/electrochem2021|title=Electrochem2021|publisher=Royal Society of Chemistry|accessdate=2021-11-23}}</ref>

==Career==

Strasser studied [[chemistry]] at the [[University of Tübingen]], at [[Stanford University]] ([[John Ross (chemist)|John Ross]]), and at the [[University of Pisa]] and obtained his [[Diplom]] in [[Physical Chemistry]] in 1995. He conducted his doctoral research under the direction of [[Gerhard Ertl]] and obtained his [[PhD]] in Physical Chemistry and [[Electrochemistry]] from the [[Fritz Haber Institute of the Max Planck Society]] in 1999.<ref>{{cite thesis |url=https://d-nb.info/962266868|title=Kinetic oscillations and spatiotemporal self-organization in electrocatalytic reactions|publisher=German National Library|accessdate=2021-11-23|last1=Strasser |first1=Klaus-Peter }}</ref> He joined [[Symyx Technologies]], [[Silicon Valley]] as a postdoctoral associate and was later promoted to Senior Member of staff and served as project leader in Electrocatalysis and Heterogeneous Catalysis. In 2004 he became assistant professor at the Department of Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering at the [[University of Houston]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.tcsuh.com/pdf/posts/events/2007-10-25.pdf|title=Dr. Peter Strasser – Texas Center for Superconductivity|publisher=University of Houston|accessdate=2021-11-23}}</ref> Since 2007 he has been the chaired professor of Electrochemistry and Electrocatalysis in the Chemical Engineering Division at [[Technische Universität Berlin]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://idw-online.de/en/news179239|title=Personalia der TU Berlin|publisher=Informationsdienst Wissenschaft|language=de|accessdate=2021-11-23}}</ref> Since 2018 he is a visiting professor at the Department of Material Science at [[Tongji University]].<ref name="TU">{{Cite web|url=https://www.technischechemie.tu-berlin.de/fileadmin/fg109/Lebenslauf/Lebenslauf_Peter_Strasser_202104.pdf|title=Peter Strasser|access-date=2021-11-23|website=[[Technische Universität Berlin]]}}</ref>

The focus of his research group is on the investigation of atomic / molecular relationships in the structure, composition and surface catalytic reactivity of [[catalysts]] for gas-phase catalytic and [[Electrocatalyst|electrocatalytic]] processes. Material-chemical issues are researched, which form the basis for electrochemical energy storage and conversion processes. These are used, for example, in regenerative energy system components such as fuel cells, batteries, water electrolysers or solar photoelectrochemical reactors to convert CO<sub>2</sub> into fuels and chemicals.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.technischechemie.tu-berlin.de/menue/research/the_ecems_group/parameter/en/|title=AK Strasser: research summary|publisher=TU Berlin|accessdate=2021-11-23}}</ref>

==Awards==

Clarivate [[Highly Cited Researcher]] in the category Chemistry 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, and 2022.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://recognition.webofscience.com/awards/highly-cited/2021/|title=Highly Cited Researchers 2021 recipients|publisher=Clarivate|accessdate=2021-11-23}}</ref>

* 2023 Carl Wagner Memorial Award, [[Electrochemical Society]] (ECS)<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.tu.berlin/en/go8716/n34726/|title=Carl Wagner Memorial Award for Prof. Dr. Peter Strasser |date=15 June 2023 |publisher=TU Berlin|accessdate=2023-06-30}}</ref>
* 2023 [[Member of the Academia Europaea]]<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Strasser_Peter |title=Peter Strasser |publisher=Academia Europaea |accessdate=2023-07-20}}</ref>
* 2023 Fellow of the Electrochemical Society (ECS)<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.electrochem.org/press-release/2023-ecs-fellows/ |title=The Electrochemical Society Names Class of 2023 ECS Fellows |publisher=The Electrochemical Society |accessdate=2023-08-15}}</ref>
* 2022 Fellow of the [[International Society of Electrochemistry]] (ISE)<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.rsc.org/events/detail/72840/16th-international-conference-on-materials-chemistry-mc16|title=16th International conference on materials chemistry |publisher=Royal Society of Chemistry|accessdate=2022-10-26}}</ref>
* 2021 Christian-Friedrich-Schönbein Medal of Honor, European Fuel Cell Forum<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.efcf.com/awards?MP=191-1955|title=Gold Medal Winners|publisher=European Fuel Cell Forum|accessdate=2021-11-23}}</ref>
* 2021 [[Faraday Medal (electrochemistry)|Faraday Medal]], [[Royal Society of Chemistry]] (RSC)<ref name="Faraday"/>
* 2020 Brian Conway Prize for Physical Electrochemistry, International Society of Electrochemistry (ISE)<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.tu.berlin/nachrichtendetails/brian-conway-preis-fuer-prof-dr-peter-strasser-2/|title=Brian Conway Preis für Prof. Dr. Peter Strasser|publisher=TU Berlin|language=de|accessdate=2021-11-23|archive-date=11 April 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210411055706/https://www.tu.berlin/nachrichtendetails/brian-conway-preis-fuer-prof-dr-peter-strasser-2/|url-status=dead}}</ref>
* 2018 Sir William Grove Award, The International Society of Hydrogen Energy<ref>{{cite web |url=https://idw-online.de/en/news697798|title=William Grove Award für Prof. Dr. Peter Strasser |publisher=Informationsdienst Wissenschaft|language=de|accessdate=2021-11-23}}</ref>
* 2018 [[Nature Publishing]] Award
* 2016 Ertl-Prize
* 2016 Otto Roelen Medal<ref>{{cite web |url=https://dechema.de/en/About+DECHEMA/Press/Press+Releases/Archive/2016/09_2016+Otto+Roelen+Medaille-p-20051135.html?no301=1|title=High value – low price: effective catalysts for fuel cells |publisher=DECHEMA|language=de|accessdate=2021-11-23}}</ref>
